critical_findings.title: Static Dummy-Token Authentication & Missing Cryptographic Signature Check
critical_findings.reproduction: Call POST /login with valid credentials. Response returns token: 'dummy-token'. Call protected endpoints with arbitrary X-User-Id header or Bearer <user_id> and backend trusts actor_id without cryptographic signature verification.
critical_findings.expected: Cryptographically signed JWT (HMAC-SHA256 or Ed25519) with expiration and tamper-proof claim verification.
critical_findings.actual: Returns static string 'dummy-token' and parses raw user IDs from headers or query parameters.
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Implement genuine PyJWT token issuance on login and enforce jwt.decode(..., algorithms=['HS256']) in auth middleware.

critical_findings.title: Unauthenticated Bypass in verify_admin_access()
critical_findings.reproduction: Execute GET http://127.0.0.1:5000/admin/dashboard/summary with zero authentication headers or query params.
critical_findings.actual: HTTP 200 OK. Missing requester_id causes verify_admin_access() to return (True, None).
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Add mandatory check in verify_admin_access(): if not requester_id: return False, (jsonify({'message': 'Authentication required'}), 401).

critical_findings.title: Bypass of Cryptographic Proof on POST /mess/entries/verify
critical_findings.reproduction: POST http://127.0.0.1:5000/mess/entries/verify with JSON body {'studentId': '<student_uuid>', 'mealType': 'LUNCH'} using Mess Staff headers.
critical_findings.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request requiring valid cryptographic passport presentation payload and Ed25519 signature.
critical_findings.actual: HTTP 201 Created / VERIFIED with MealEntry record created without any presentation signature verification.
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Make qr_payload and cryptographic presentation verification strictly mandatory in verify_meal_entry().

critical_findings.title: Ed25519 Private Key Generated in Software Space rather than Hardware Secure Enclave
critical_findings.reproduction: Inspect PassportCryptoService.getOrCreatePublicKey(). Keypair is generated via Dart Ed25519 algorithm and written to FlutterSecureStorage.
critical_findings.expected: Hardware-backed non-exportable key generation inside Android Keystore / iOS Secure Enclave.
critical_findings.actual: Software-generated 32-byte seed stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences via FlutterSecureStorage.
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Clarify architectural documentation that key security relies on EncryptedSharedPreferences rather than hardware-enclave non-exportable TPM keys.

critical_findings.title: Hardcoded Mock Subjects and Empty onTap Callback in Legacy Timetable
critical_findings.reproduction: Open TimetableScreen and tap any class card. onTap callback is an empty closure () {}.
critical_findings.expected: Navigates to class detail or displays real scheduled curriculum from backend.
critical_findings.actual: Displays hardcoded static mock list and card taps perform no action.
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Connect timetable screen to /academic/updates or class schedule API and wire up card navigation.

critical_findings.title: Hardcoded Fallback Classes when Teacher Has No Active Schedule
critical_findings.reproduction: Log in as teacher with no classes. TeacherHomeContent displays default hardcoded cards ('Data Structures', 'Computer Networks') instead of empty state illustration.
critical_findings.expected: Clean empty state illustration with 'No classes assigned today'.
critical_findings.recommended_fix: Render dedicated empty state widget when assigned classes list is empty.
